capabilities: update a frontmatter modified date field on note edit
add a created date to notes missing one
exclude folders or single files from automatic updates
format the date as text or a wikilink via MomentJS
append each edit date to a history array
extras: Documents a known 'Merging changes' popup caused by Obsidian's own frontmatter handling; warns that removing the append_modified_update property deletes all saved history entries; history frequency is configurable only by editing data.json.
problem: Obsidian does not record when a note was last meaningfully edited, and filesystem modified time changes even for edits made outside Obsidian or by other tools.

relations.evidence: If you have another plugin like Linter or an external application updating your files

summary: Frontmatter automation that updates a modified date property whenever a note is edited in Obsidian, with optional created date and edit history.
